dedupe_keys.name: d7 3 report on how to create common european in pipe defect scenarios

description: Tait, Simon at University of Sheffield publishes reference specifications for physical in-pipe defect surrogates through Co-UDlabs. The report describes how to manufacture laboratory defects, relates them to the EN 13508-2 classification and explains their use in testing repair and inspection technologies. Water-utility input helped choose representative defect types. Coverage is laboratory sewer-pipe testing with a European defect-classification scope; no observation period applies. Zenodo provides a PDF reference report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the public metadata do not list every dimension or manufacturing tolerance, and the report is a physical-test specification; it does not provide measured failure probabilities. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
